scope: Follow-up selected seven failing technical expressions across casing/context and touch offsets
findings: All 28 surface/context variants change at at least one tested offset.
Uppercase does not protect: HTTPS→BATTLE, MQTT→MATT, INDEX.TSX→INDEX.TAX at center.
Context sometimes protects: sunucu https and sunucu csrf unchanged at center; not a general protection.
limits: Selected known failing cases; 70/84 is NOT overall technical vocabulary error rate.
Core typing through production packs, not simulator or physical keyboard.
